definitionEn: Used to show what someone or something is, or to indicate existence.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: She is a very talented doctor.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Ella es una doctora muy talentosa.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: To be successful in this industry requires persistent dedication.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Ser exitoso en esta industria requiere dedicación constante.

definitionEn: Used to connect words, phrases, or clauses together.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I like apples and bananas.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Me gustan las manzanas y los plátanos.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: He analyzed the data and presented his findings to the board.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Analizó los datos y presentó sus hallazgos a la junta.

definitionEn: Used to show belonging, connection, or relation between things.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: This is the capital city of France.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Esta es la capital de Francia.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: The core of the problem lies in poor communication.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: El núcleo del problema radica en una mala comunicación.

definitionEn: Used to indicate direction, destination, or a point reached.

alternateSensesJson.definitionEn: Used before a verb to indicate the infinitive form.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I want to learn English.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Quiero aprender inglés.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: It is essential to understand the underlying principles.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Es esencial comprender los principios subyacentes.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: We are going to the supermarket.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Vamos al supermercado.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: She dedicated her entire career to scientific research.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Ella dedicó toda su carrera a la investigación científica.

definitionEn: Used before countable nouns when mentioning them for the first time or not specifying a particular one.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I saw a cat in the garden.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Vi un gato en el jardín.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: Establishing a strong foundation requires time and patience.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Establecer una base sólida requiere tiempo y paciencia.

definitionEn: Inside or within a space, place, or period of time.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: My keys are in the bag.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Mis llaves están en el bolso.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: The discovery resulted in a major breakthrough in medicine.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: El descubrimiento resultó en un gran avance en la medicina.

definitionEn: To possess, own, or hold something.

alternateSensesJson.contextualHint: como verbo auxiliar para tiempos compuestos
alternateSensesJson.definitionEn: Used with a past participle to form perfect tenses.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: We have already eaten lunch.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Ya hemos almorzado.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: They would have arrived earlier if traffic hadn't been so heavy.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Habrían llegado más temprano si el tráfico no hubiera estado tan pesado.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I have two brothers and a dog.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Tengo dos hermanos y un perro.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: Successful entrepreneurs often have extensive networks of professional contacts.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Los emprendedores exitosos a menudo tienen amplias redes de contactos profesionales.

definitionEn: Used to refer to a thing, animal, situation, or idea that has already been mentioned.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I bought a new phone, and it works very well.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Compré un teléfono nuevo y funciona muy bien.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: Understanding the core problem makes it easier to find a permanent solution.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Comprender el problema central hace que sea más fácil encontrar una solución permanente.

definitionEn: Used to refer to the person or people being spoken or written to.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: Are you ready to order food?
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: ¿Estás listo para pedir comida?
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: If you wish to succeed in this industry, dedication is mandatory.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Si deseas tener éxito en esta industria, la dedicación es obligatoria.

definitionEn: Used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: My brother is a doctor, and he works at the local hospital.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Mi hermano es médico y trabaja en el hospital local.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: Although he was exhausted, he completed the project on time.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Aunque estaba agotado, completó el proyecto a tiempo.

definitionEn: Used to state the purpose of something, a recipient, or a duration of time.
grammarPattern: for + noun / for + period of time

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: This gift is for you.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Este regalo es para ti.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: They lived in Madrid for three years before relocating to London.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Vivieron en Madrid durante tres años antes de mudarse a Londres.

definitionEn: Used to refer to two or more people, animals, or things previously mentioned.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: My parents are visiting, and they are staying until Sunday.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Mis padres están de visita y se quedan hasta el domingo.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: Scientists published the report once they had verified all the empirical data.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Los científicos publicaron el informe una vez que hubieron verificado todos los datos empíricos.

definitionEn: Used with an auxiliary verb to form the negative.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: She is not coming to the party tonight.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Ella no va a venir a la fiesta esta noche.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: Had we known the traffic would be so heavy, we would not have taken that route.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Si hubiéramos sabido que el tráfico iba a ser tan pesado, no habríamos tomado esa ruta.

definitionEn: Used to identify a specific person or thing observed or heard far away.

alternateSensesJson.definitionEn: Used to introduce a subordinate clause expressing a statement or reason.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I think that we should leave now.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Pienso que deberíamos irnos ahora.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: It is essential that all employees attend the annual safety briefing.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Es fundamental que todos los empleados asistan a la sesión informativa anual de seguridad.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: What is that over there?
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: ¿Qué es eso de ahí?
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: That which does not kill us makes us stronger.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Aquello que no nos mata nos hace más fuertes.

definitionEn: Used by the speaker to refer to themselves and one or more other people as the subject of a verb.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: We are going to the supermarket.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Nosotros vamos al supermercado.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: We find ourselves facing unprecedented economic challenges.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Nos encontramos enfrentando desafíos económicos sin precedentes.

definitionEn: Physically in contact with and supported by a surface.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: Your keys are on the kitchen table.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Tus llaves están sobre la mesa de la cocina.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: The historic agreement was signed on the condition that both parties compromise.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: El acuerdo histórico se firmó con la condición de que ambas partes lleguen a un compromiso.

definitionEn: Accompanied by; possessing or using something.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I like to drink coffee with milk.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Me gusta tomar café con leche.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: She approached the delicate negotiation with remarkable poise and confidence.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Abordó la delicada negociación con notable aplomo y confianza.

definitionEn: Used to identify a specific person or thing close at hand or being experienced.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: This is my new car.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Este es mi coche nuevo.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: This demonstrates the urgent need for a comprehensive policy overhaul.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Esto demuestra la necesidad urgente de una revisión integral de la política.

definitionEn: Used by the speaker or writer to refer to himself or herself as the subject of a verb.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I like learning English every day.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Me gusta aprender inglés todos los días.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: I would appreciate it if you could send me the report.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Agradecería que pudiera enviarme el informe.

definitionEn: To perform an action, activity, or task.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I always do my homework after school.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Siempre hago mis deberes después del colegio.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: Scientists continue to do extensive research on renewable energy.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Los científicos continúan haciendo una investigación exhaustiva sobre energías renovables.
